ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Gyftr Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Copy of Newspaper Publication — Gyftr Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
Resignation — Gyftr Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Mr. Kapil Garg and Ms. Gunjan Jain as Non- Executive Director of the company w.e.f. August 14, 2026.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Gyftr Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
